releaseNotes.headline: Sign in to Claude from Settings
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.10 adds a Claude sign-in button to Manage AI Tools and shows every supported local tool on one page without scrolling.

highlights.title: Sign in to Claude in place
highlights.detail: Sign In on the Claude row runs Claude Code’s own login, opens the sign-in page, and takes the code you paste back. Your plan limits appear right after.

highlights.title: Every local tool at a glance
highlights.detail: ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Grok Build each get one row with their state, a rail switch, and their limits behind a disclosure.

highlights.title: Straight answers
highlights.detail: When Claude Code bills an API key through a helper, the row says there are no plan limits yet and offers the sign-in instead.
